subject: MAP: Nimbus Health pilot — security package and SOC 2 milestone
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@nimbushealth.com>, Tom Liu <tom.liu@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Nimbus Health pilot — security package and SOC 2 milestone

Hi Jane / Tom —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. As promised, attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) to capture milestones, owners, and target dates so we stay aligned on the pilot and the security review cadence. Highlights from our call and the MAP draft: 

- Pilot scope: 1 LLM-powered document summarization workflow (PHI stripped at ingestion)
- MAP milestone we discussed: Security review + SOC 2 package delivery before pilot kickoff
- Target close: 2026-08-06 (you asked for a 2-week security review window)

Requested from Nimbus for the security milestone:
- Completed security questionnaire (we can provide a Redwood version, if easier)
- SOC 2 artifacts/evidence list (control owners and sample artifacts)
- Confirmation of NDA / legal redline timing

What Redwood will deliver (proposed):
- Redwood SOC2 package: questionnaire (fillable PDF), evidence matrix, sample config screenshots, and an attestation letter
- Initial delivery date proposed: 2026-07-29 (gives Nimbus 4 business days before your internal review window)

Please review the attached MAP (Nimbus_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx) and let me know if the milestone owners and dates match your expectations. If you prefer, we can turn the security milestone into a short checklist in the MAP for easier handoffs.

Next steps / asks:
1) Jane: confirm security review window and the names of any internal reviewers we should loop in (security contact + procurement)
2) Tom: confirm whether you want the questionnaire in Word/PDF or via an online form
3) Nimbus: confirm the NDA legal owner and expected redline turnaround

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Nimbus_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP draft)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Nimbus Health pilot — security package and SOC 2 milestone

Karthik / Markus —

Saw the MAP draft. Quick internal notes on owners / artifacts so we can hit the 7/29 delivery: 

- Owner (questionnaire + attestation): Monica Patel (me) — I'll own assembling the artifact package
- Owner (evidence matrix + control samples): Markus Klein (controls and infra screenshots)
- Owner (legal / NDA): I'll loop in Legal; prio is to get the NDA redline within 3 business days

Suggested deliverables for 7/29 (SOC2 package):
- Completed questionnaire (PDF fillable)
- Evidence matrix CSV mapping controls -> sample files (SOC2_evidence_matrix.csv)
- Config screenshots (GCP IAM, VPC peering, KMS key usage) — redacted for account IDs
- SOC 2 attestation letter (if available; if not, we can provide SOC 2 report summary and an attestation statement)

Dependencies / risks:
- Legal redline on NDA (if they need >3 business days that pushes our timeline)
- If Nimbus requests full SOC2 Type II report, that will need an extra step (we currently provide SOC2 Type II report summary for customers under NDA)

I'll prep the evidence matrix template and drop in the Drive folder by EOD today. Attaching the matrix I'm planning to use as a template.

Thanks —
Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Attachments: SOC2_evidence_matrix.csv

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@nimbushealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Liu <tom.liu@nimbushealth.com>, sec.ops@nimbushealth.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Nimbus Health pilot — security package and SOC 2 milestone

Karthik / Monica —

Thanks for the quick follow-up and the MAP. Nimbus is aligned on the idea of receiving a consolidated SOC2 package and a short questionnaire. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Security review window: we will run the internal review the week of 2026-08-02; ideally we get your full package by 2026-07-29 so our security team has 4 business days to triage
- Questionnaire format: PDF is fine — we prefer a single file we can annotate and return
- Evidence we need as samples: KMS key policy, network diagram showing VPC peering and ingress rules, and data retention policy related to PII/PHI

One additional ask: can Redwood provide an attestation letter or a contact at your auditor? Our procurement team requires either a SOC2 attestation or the auditor contact to validate scope.

I've attached a short list of our security questions to make sure we're aligned on scope (Nimbus_security_questions_v1.pdf). Also cc'ing our security ops alias for any deeper technical questions.

If you confirm the 7/29 delivery of the package, we'll keep 8/02–8/06 blocked for the security review and hope to proceed to procurement the following week.

Best,
Jane Doe
Head of IT Security | Nimbus Health
jane.doe@nimbushealth.com

Attachments: Nimbus_security_questions_v1.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@nimbushealth.com>, Tom Liu <tom.liu@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Nimbus Health pilot — security package and SOC 2 milestone

Jane / Tom —

Appreciate the quick confirmation and the question list. Redwood will deliver the SOC2 package with the following commitments: 

Milestones (final MAP will be updated in Drive):
- 2026-07-22: Redwood confirms owners (this email)
- 2026-07-26: Draft questionnaire returned to Nimbus for quick clarifications (if any)
- 2026-07-29: Final SOC2 package delivered to Nimbus (questionnaire PDF + evidence matrix + sample artifacts + attestation letter or report summary)
- 2026-08-02 to 2026-08-06: Nimbus internal security review window
- 2026-08-06: Target contract close (per MAP)

Assigned internal owners / responsibilities:
- Questionnaire + attestation: Monica Patel (monica_patel@redwood.com) — will send PDF by 7/26 for your quick review
- Evidence matrix + sample artifacts: Markus Klein (markus_klein@redwood.com) — will populate the matrix and include screenshots named: redwood_kms_policy.png, redwood_network_diagram.png, redwood_data_retention.pdf
- NDA / legal redlines: Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer@redwood.com) — please route any legal changes to legal@redwood.com; we ask for redlines within 3 business days to keep 7/29 on track

Dependencies / notes:
- If Nimbus needs the auditor contact or a formal SOC2 report, Monica will coordinate (this may require an NDA). If needed, provide a secure email for the auditor contact; we can also supply an attestation letter as interim evidence
- All artifacts will be uploaded to the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3-nimbus-map

I'll update the MAP with these milestone dates and owners tonight. If anything shifts on your side (NDA timing or additional control samples), flag it here and we'll re-plan. Looking forward to keeping momentum.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments referenced: redwood_kms_policy.png (sample), redwood_network_diagram.png (sample), redwood_data_retention.pdf (sample)
